author: Tobias Ellinghaus
name: import_filter_manager
description: Adds a dropdown of selectable import filters to the import dialog and lets other scripts register new filters.
description-extensive: This adds a menu to darktable's import dialog where you can pick a filter that decides which photos actually get imported. On its own it just provides the menu; other companion scripts supply the actual filtering rules you can choose from. It's a foundation piece that makes importing more flexible for people who want fine control over what comes into their library.
